title: Canonical Proposal
description: Complete DB-row-to-JSON serialization contract for the current committed PostgreSQL canonical_proposals table using the repository's default node-postgres text parsers followed by JSON.stringify/parse. It is an offline export/inspection boundary, not the curator route DTO or a proposal-create request schema; workspace authorization remains enforced by application checks and RLS.

id.description: PostgreSQL UUID primary key, defaulted by gen_random_uuid().

group_id.description: Tenant namespace. Migration 19 enforces the strict format check.

score.description: DECIMAL(4,3) curator confidence returned by the default pg NUMERIC parser as a decimal string; the database check limits it to 0 through 1.

reasoning.description: Nullable curator-engine reasoning for the score.

tier.description: Confidence tier enforced by a database CHECK.

status.description: Lifecycle status enforced by a database CHECK; default pending.

trace_ref.description: Nullable BIGINT events.id reference returned by pg as a precision-safe decimal string.

created_at.description: NOT NULL TIMESTAMPTZ parsed by pg as Date and emitted by JSON serialization as an ISO date-time string.

decided_at.description: Nullable decision TIMESTAMPTZ serialized from pg Date to an ISO date-time string.

witness_hash.description: Nullable SHAKE-256 decision witness text; migrations do not impose a format CHECK.

notion_synced_at.description: Nullable Notion sync TIMESTAMPTZ serialized from pg Date to an ISO date-time string.

approved_memory_id.description: Application-produced invariant: successful current approval stores a deterministic UUID, while pending/rejected rows use NULL. The physical PostgreSQL column is unconstrained TEXT, not a database UUID guarantee.

workspace_id.description: Stored workspace scope added by migration 39. SQL NULL represents a quarantined legacy row; current app writes must persist a non-empty server-resolved value enforced by restrictive RLS.

proposal_version.description: Application serialization invariant for the BIGINT revision: a positive decimal string preserves precision for review and receipt consumers. Migrations provide NOT NULL/default/increment behavior but do not add a positive-value CHECK.
